subject: Purchasing route & invoice specs — onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Katherine Lopez <k.lopez@halohealth.com>, Halo Health Procurement <procurement@halohealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Purchasing route & invoice specs — onboarding checklist

Hi Katherine (and procurement team),

Thanks again for the call today — great to hear about Halo Health's pilot goals and timelines. Quick written recap + a short set of asks so we can get legal/finance aligned on our side and unblock procurement: 

Summary from today's call:
- Pilot: 3-month evaluation, expected start: 2026-07-01.
- Expected spend profile: low initial usage ramp, then steady traffic; likely to scale after successful pilot.
- Technical: private VPC deployment preferred.

Open items / asks for procurement readiness:
1) Purchasing route: will you be using a Purchase Order (PO) or company card / marketplace purchase? If PO, please confirm whether your AP team requires PO number on invoice and whether they will issue a PDF PO or a signed PO PDF.
2) Invoice requirements: preferred invoice recipient (billing@halohealth.com?), billing address, VAT/tax ID to appear on invoice, and whether you require a specific invoice format (line items, cost centers).
3) Net terms: do you have standard net terms (Net 30/Net 45)? Any PO-level SLA/penalty language we should be aware of?
4) Marketplace interest: does Halo Health prefer buying via cloud marketplace (AWS Marketplace) to centralize billing, or does procurement prefer vendor invoicing?

I've attached a Redwood invoice template to show the default fields we populate. If you can send your PO template (or a sample invoice format), that will speed up finance review on both sides.

Next steps proposed:
- Katherine: confirm purchasing route and billing contact + send PO template if PO route.
- Stephanie/Vivek (Redwood finance): review any submitted PO template and confirm we can meet invoice formatting + net terms.
- Jordan: coordinate SOW / account setup once commercial path decided.

Thanks — short replies welcome.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attach: Redwood_Invoice_Template.pdf
From: Katherine Lopez <k.lopez@halohealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Purchasing route & invoice specs — onboarding checklist

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear summary. Looping in our procurement mailbox for specifics (procurement@halohealth.com).

Answers below: 
- Purchasing route: Procurement prefers a PO for vendor engagements of this size (even during pilot). We will issue a PO PDF with a PO number.
- Invoice requirements: We need the PO number printed on the invoice, a PDF copy emailed to billing@halohealth.com, and a separate copy uploaded to our vendor portal. Billing address: Halo Health, Accounts Payable, 2100 Central Parkway, Suite 500, San Jose, CA 95134.
- Tax/VAT: Halo Health US entity is not VAT-registered. Our W-9 will be required for tax processing — I can attach it.
- Net terms: Standard is Net 30 from invoice date. Please confirm Redwood accepts Net 30.
- Marketplace: Procurement prefers direct vendor invoicing to maintain our internal tracking; marketplace purchases are only used in exceptional cases.

Sending our PO template (attached) — it has the fields our AP team needs. Please confirm you can send invoice with PO number and PDF.

Thanks,
Katherine
Head of Procurement (interim)
Halo Health
